function.name: panel_add_action
function.description: Add a new action button to an agent's panel. Action buttons appear on the agent detail page. Actions can be 'script' (bash script executed as run_as_user) or 'prompt' (text sent to agent session). Use {{param_name}} placeholders in content for user-fillable parameters. Agents can only add actions to their own panel (unless super agent).

agent_id.description: The agent ID whose panel to add the action to. Must be your own agent ID (unless you are super agent).

label.description: Display label for the action button.

action_type.description: Type of action. 'script' runs a predefined bash script. 'prompt' sends text to the agent session.

content.description: Script body (for 'script' type) or prompt text (for 'prompt' type). Use {{param_name}} placeholders for user-fillable values.

params.description: Parameter definitions for {{placeholders}} in content. Each param is an object with: name, label, type (text/password/number/select), required (boolean), and default (optional string).

label.description: Display label shown to the user.

sort_order.description: Display order position. Lower numbers appear first. Default: 0.

confirm_dialog.description: Whether to show a confirmation dialog before executing this action. Default: false.

slash_command.description: Optional chat slash command that runs this action, e.g. 'deploy' makes /deploy execute it. Lowercase letters, digits, '-' and '_', max 32 chars, must start with a letter. Must not collide with a built-in command or another action of this agent. Params are passed positionally: /deploy prod v2.

function.name: panel_update_action
function.description: Update an existing action button on an agent's panel. Only agent_id and action_id are required — all other fields update only when provided. Agents can only update actions on their own panel (unless super agent).

agent_id.description: The agent ID whose panel the action belongs to. Must be your own agent ID (unless you are super agent).

action_id.description: The ID of the action to update.

label.description: New display label for the action button (optional).

content.description: New script body or prompt text (optional).

confirm_dialog.description: Whether to show a confirmation dialog before executing this action (optional).

slash_command.description: Chat slash command that runs this action, e.g. 'deploy' makes /deploy execute it (optional). Pass an empty string to remove the assignment. Must not collide with a built-in command or another action of this agent.

function.name: panel_remove_action
function.description: Remove an action button from an agent's panel. This permanently deletes the action. Agents can only remove actions from their own panel (unless super agent).

agent_id.description: The agent ID whose panel the action belongs to. Must be your own agent ID (unless you are super agent).

action_id.description: The ID of the action to remove.

function.name: panel_list_actions
function.description: List all action buttons on an agent's panel. Returns actions ordered by sort_order then id. Agents can only list their own panel's actions (unless super agent).

agent_id.description: The agent ID whose panel actions to list. Must be your own agent ID (unless you are super agent).
